inspiration.observed_pattern: UPDATE IGNORE suppresses a duplicate-key conflict and preserves the conflicting row.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two independently authored candidate rows and one occupied unique code. UPDATE IGNORE attempts one conflicting and one free reassignment, removing names, active flags, and source-domain values while retaining partial-mutation behavior.

fixture_notes: Row 1 targets occupied code 30 and must remain code 10; row 2 targets free code 40 and must update.
determinism_notes: Fixed IDs and codes are ordered by primary key; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE update_ignore_min (row_id INT PRIMARY KEY, code INT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

steps.sql: UPDATE IGNORE update_ignore_min SET code = CASE WHEN row_id = 1 THEN 30 ELSE 40 END WHERE row_id IN (1, 2)

checks.sql: SELECT row_id, code FROM update_ignore_min ORDER BY row_id
